verdict.rationale: Fern documents scheduled Fern Agent automations that open pull requests. That lets a team review the changes an automation proposes, but nothing shows the automation definitions themselves being versioned, reviewed, or rolled back. Docs 'Versions' are a reader-facing dropdown for content releases, an adjacent feature that does not apply to automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
